relationships.subject: dorsal horn astrocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: DREADD-induced astrogliosis in the dorsal horn was indicated by increased astrocyte number and GFAP immunoreactivity, which occurred alongside mechanical and heat hypersensitivity in GFAP-hM3D(Gq) mice

relationships.subject: dorsal horn astrocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: The capillary network (reduced CD31) and angiogenic proteome were reduced in the dorsal horn of CNO-treated GFAP-hM3D(Gq) mice.

relationships.subject: VEGF-A165b
relationships.evidence_quote: Diminished angiogenesis and pain hypersensitivity were ameliorated by VEGF-A165b supplementation.

relationships.subject: dorsal horn astrocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: This demonstrates that astrocytes in the dorsal horn modulate the blood-spinal cord barrier, impacting upon nociceptive processing and pain hypersensitivity.

key_findings: Chemogenetic astrocyte activation in the dorsal horn reduces capillary network and angiogenic proteome and causes pain hypersensitivity
VEGF-A165b supplementation rescues angiogenesis deficit and hypersensitivity
